note: The m1 dates lane (20 Oct 2026): official pages read again on 20 October 2026 for this year's and next year's applicants: the app's own data, not in the design's SEED. Every fact carries the page it was read on and the day it was read; a day a page has not published stays unwritten (null, needs_verification) and the app says "date being confirmed". rules.ts seedRecords() folds it into US version 4 (dated.universities), UK version 2 (cycles) and DE version 2 (dated.universities).

tum.name: Technical University of Munich
tum.year_basis: The page states a standing rule with no year ("if applying for a bachelor's degree program for the winter semester, by July 15"). Read on 20 October 2026, the next winter semester a school leaver of 2027 can start is 2027/28, so the day is 15 July 2027. A summer-semester start (15 January) is not written: it begins in April, before a school year ending in June.
